scripts.test: cd apps/api && uv run --all-packages pytest && cd ../.. && npm run test --workspace apps/web
scripts.test:slow: cd apps/api && uv run --all-packages pytest -m slow
scripts.stack:up: c=${STACK_COMPOSE:-$(command -v podman-compose >/dev/null 2>&1 && echo podman-compose || echo docker compose)}; $c -f compose.yaml up -d --build --remove-orphans
scripts.stack:down: c=${STACK_COMPOSE:-$(command -v podman-compose >/dev/null 2>&1 && echo podman-compose || echo docker compose)}; $c -f compose.yaml down --remove-orphans
scripts.stack:logs: c=${STACK_COMPOSE:-$(command -v podman-compose >/dev/null 2>&1 && echo podman-compose || echo docker compose)}; $c -f compose.yaml logs -f --tail 100
scripts.stack:reset: npm run --silent stack:down -- --volumes && npm run --silent stack:up
